import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows

MAIL = "x@example.invalid"


# ---
def make(last, section, email=MAIL):
    return Student("id", last, "Pat", section, email)


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    # ---
    def test_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        pupils = [make("Zed", "A1"), make("Li", "B22")]
        rows = contact_rows(pupils)
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Li, Pat"))
        first = rows[0].index("B22")
        self.assertEqual(first, rows[1].index("A1"))

    # ---
    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows([make("Zed", "A1", None)])
        self.assertIn("Zed, Pat", str(caught.exception))

    # ---
    def test_empty_list(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
